title: Sources: Nvidia verbally told cloud compute clients to sell 51%+ of their services to non-Chinese companies, imposing new limits on China's access to AI chips (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Nvidia verbally told cloud compute clients to sell 51%+ of their services to non-Chinese companies, imposing new limits on China's access to AI chips — Nvidia is ordering its data centre partners to reduce exposure to Chinese customers in a move that further restrains China's ability …
